columns.comment: First day of the revenue month (Apr-2024 to Sep-2026).

columns.comment: Last calendar day of the month.

columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter 1-4 (Q1 Apr-Jun, Q2 Jul-Sep, Q3 Oct-Dec, Q4 Jan-Mar).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter_label

columns.name: fiscal_half

columns.comment: Fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1 (Apr-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_half_label

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Product family of the revenue line: Corporate Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance, FX (product feeds) or Other TB & Advisory (relationship P&L only).
columns.name: product_family

columns.comment: Business line of the family: Lending, Transaction Banking or Markets.
columns.name: business_line

columns.comment: Product feed (silver.fin_client_revenue), Relationship P&L allocation (Other TB & Advisory from silver.fin_relationship_pnl) or Prior-year only (zero row kept so prior-year sums are complete).
columns.name: revenue_source

columns.comment: True for the families in the finance relationship P&L (Corporate Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Other TB & Advisory); FX trading and trade-finance fees sit outside it.
columns.name: is_relationship_pnl_line

columns.comment: Net interest income in USD for the month (lending margin, deposit spread).
columns.name: nii_usd

columns.comment: Fee and commission income in USD for the month (commitment / arrangement, payments, trade, other TB and advisory fees).
columns.name: fee_usd

columns.comment: Trading revenue in USD for the month (FX).
columns.name: trading_usd

columns.comment: Total revenue in USD for the month = nii_usd + fee_usd + trading_usd. Additive.
columns.name: total_revenue_usd

columns.comment: Volume behind the revenue in USD (drawn balance, deposit balance, payment count, FX notional or trade value) - a driver, not money earned; never add across families.
columns.name: activity_basis_usd

columns.comment: Direct product cost allocated to the line in USD (cost to serve).
columns.name: direct_cost_usd

columns.comment: Relationship-manager cost allocated to the line in USD.
columns.name: rm_cost_usd

columns.comment: Operations cost allocated in USD (account upkeep, payment processing).
columns.name: operations_cost_usd

columns.comment: Head-office overhead allocated in USD.
columns.name: ho_allocation_usd

columns.comment: Total allocated cost (opex) in USD = direct + RM + operations + HO. Additive.
columns.name: allocated_cost_usd

columns.comment: Credit cost = expected loss for the month in USD (PD x LGD x EAD / 12), on the Corporate Lending row only (0 elsewhere). Additive.
columns.name: credit_cost_usd

columns.comment: Month-on-month change in the IFRS 9 ECL allowance in USD (impairment charge; positive = provision build), Corporate Lending row only - information, not part of net contribution.
columns.name: ecl_charge_usd

columns.comment: Net contribution in USD = total revenue - allocated cost - credit cost (pre-tax, product view incl. FX and trade). Additive.
columns.name: net_contribution_usd

columns.comment: Exposure at default at the month-end in USD (Corporate Lending row only). Monthly balance - average it, never sum across months.
columns.name: ead_usd

columns.comment: Risk-weighted assets at the month-end in USD (Corporate Lending row only). Monthly balance: RoRWA = 12 x SUM(relationship_net_profit_usd) / SUM(rwa_usd); Average RWA = SUM(rwa_usd) / months.
columns.name: rwa_usd

columns.comment: Economic (unexpected-loss) capital at the month-end in USD (Corporate Lending row only) - the RAROC denominator. Monthly balance.
columns.name: economic_capital_usd

columns.comment: Capital allocated at the 12.5% target CET1 ratio of RWA in USD (Corporate Lending row only). Monthly balance.
columns.name: allocated_capital_usd

columns.comment: Book equity allocated at 9% of EAD in USD (finance relationship-ROE basis; Corporate Lending row only). Monthly balance.
columns.name: book_equity_usd

columns.comment: Monthly charge for allocated capital at the 10% cost of equity in USD (Corporate Lending row only). Additive.
columns.name: cost_of_capital_usd

columns.comment: Relationship net profit (pre-tax) on the finance hurdle basis in USD: the quarterly relationship P&L (lending + deposit + payments + other TB and advisory revenue - cost to serve - expected loss, excl. FX and trade fees) spread evenly over the quarter's months; Corporate Lending row only, null without credit. Numerator of RoRWA and RAROC. Additive.
columns.name: relationship_net_profit_usd

columns.comment: total_revenue_usd of the same client, family and month one year earlier (0 when none) - Revenue YoY % = SUM(total_revenue_usd) / SUM(total_revenue_py_usd) - 1 (prior year available from Apr-2025).
columns.name: total_revenue_py_usd

columns.comment: net_contribution_usd of the same client, family and month one year earlier (0 when none).
columns.name: net_contribution_py_usd

columns.comment: True on the Corporate Lending row of a client-month with credit exposure - the only row carrying RWA, capital, credit cost and relationship net profit.
columns.name: is_capital_row

columns.comment: True on exactly one row per client-month with current activity (the capital row, else the largest revenue line): count clients and read the client-month / quarter attributes on it.
columns.name: is_primary_row

columns.comment: True for zero rows kept because the line had revenue 12 months earlier (all current amounts 0).
columns.name: is_prior_year_only

columns.comment: True when the line belongs to a credit relationship whose revenue ties to the cent to the quarterly relationship P&L.
columns.name: is_pnl_reconciled

columns.comment: Products the client held or used at the month-end (gold.fact_product_holding_monthly) - Products per Client = SUM on primary rows / clients.
columns.name: products_held_count

columns.comment: Bucket of products_held_count: 0 products, 1 product, 2 products, 3-4 products, 5-7 products or 8+ products.
columns.name: product_count_bucket

columns.comment: Client-month flag: the client's only products are credit facilities (no deposits, payments, trade, FX or cash management).
columns.name: is_single_product_lending

columns.comment: Client-month flag: the client holds nothing but deposit products.
columns.name: is_deposit_only

columns.comment: True when the client is known only to the credit system - a credit obligor with no core-banking customer, treasury counterparty or trade party record (storyline 8 lending-only relationships).
columns.name: is_lending_only_relationship

columns.comment: True when the client has RWA in the fiscal quarter of the month (a credit relationship with a return to measure).
columns.name: has_rwa_in_quarter

columns.comment: Client RoRWA for the fiscal quarter of the month (12 x relationship net profit / RWA over the quarter's months), winsorised to -0.25..1.00 like the finance P&L; primary rows only - use MEDIAN across clients, not AVG.
columns.name: rorwa_fq

columns.comment: Client RAROC for the fiscal quarter of the month (12 x relationship net profit / economic capital), winsorised to -0.25..1.00; primary rows only - use MEDIAN across clients.
columns.name: raroc_fq

columns.comment: True when the client's unwinsorised RoRWA over the fiscal quarter of the month is below the RoRWA hurdle (1.2%, dim_threshold RORWA_HURDLE) - the below-hurdle flag (also for questions saying 8% hurdle). Repeated on every row of the client's months in that quarter; null without RWA.
columns.name: below_rorwa_hurdle

columns.comment: True when the client's unwinsorised RAROC over the fiscal quarter of the month is below the 12% RAROC hurdle (dim_threshold RAROC_HURDLE); null without RWA.
columns.name: below_raroc_hurdle

comment: Client revenue and profitability by product family and month (integration fact of Account Planning, Opportunity Identification and Client Profitability; Apr-2024 to Sep-2026): revenue (NII, fees, trading), allocated cost, credit cost (expected loss), net contribution and the capital consumed (RWA, economic and allocated capital, carried on the Corporate Lending row). Revenue = the product feeds plus the relationship P&L line 'Other TB & Advisory' (other transaction-banking, advisory, structuring and agency fees reported only in the quarterly relationship P&L). Returns: RoRWA = 12 x SUM(relationship_net_profit_usd) / SUM(rwa_usd) and RAROC = 12 x SUM(relationship_net_profit_usd) / SUM(economic_capital_usd) over any set of months (hurdles RoRWA 1.2% and RAROC 12%, gold.dim_threshold; 'below the 8% hurdle' means below_rorwa_hurdle). Revenue, cost, net contribution and profit are additive; RWA and capital are monthly balances (sum them only inside the annualised ratios, or average them). Grain: one row per golden client x month x product family.
